title: [minigraph.py] Crashes upon <DhcpRelays></DhcpRelays> in VlanInterface section
author: taoyl-ms
body:

**Description**
In minigraph.py:
```
            if vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))) is not None:
                vintfdhcpservers = vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))).text
                vdhcpserver_list = vintfdhcpservers.split(';')
                vlan_attributes['dhcp_servers'] = vdhcpserver_list

```
This will crash upon case of `<DhcpRelays></DhcpRelays>`, i.e. `vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))) is not None` but `vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))).text is None`.


<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
Create a minigraph with `<DhcpRelays></DhcpRelays>` in `<VlanInterface>` section, then `sonic-cfggen -m`.

comments.author: jleveque
comments.body:
I feel like the scope of this issue is larger than just the `<DhcpRelays></DhcpRelays>` tag, and could pose an issue with any tag that contains no data. I think we should either:

a.) Explicitly not allow empty tags (therefore undefined behavior is acceptable)

OR

b.) Add support throughout minigraph.py to gracefully handle empty tags.
